title: Floral carpet (dark blue ground)
notes: Floral carpet (dark blue ground). 18th century, Khanates Period, Azerbaijan. Türk ve İslam Eserleri Museum , Istanbul. Acquired 1922. inv. no 184 (3943) from Cerablus (Kargamish, Gaziantep, Turkey). 200 x 536 cm. published Serare Yetkin's "Early Caucasian carpets in Turkey", plate 54.
